$Comment: A Wild Turkey: the feast's own turkey, out in the daytime woods and fields while Harvest Feast runs, and what the host's hunts count. It is a Variant of Template_Animal_Neutral carrying the game's Turkey's own Modify, with the nameplate changed, its flock made of feast turkeys only, and IsMemory false so a creature that walks a few weeks a year stays out of the Memories collection. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role, and the creature never spawns, so add a key here only if the game's own Turkey role already names it. It drops what the game's turkey drops (raw wild meat and a light hide), and taming one still turns it into the game's own tame turkey. It spawns only through this pack's calendar rule (CalendarSpawns/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Spawns.json).
